_doc: Known, accepted serious/critical accessibility violations on the gated template pages. The suite FAILS on any serious/critical violation NOT matched here, so new regressions are caught. This list is currently EMPTY — the gated pages have zero serious/critical violations in both light and dark themes. Add an entry only with a written reason, and burn it back down.
_fixed: Resolved rather than baselined: (1) brand-colour contrast across all platforms + house brick, in BOTH themes, via the theme-aware accessible-ink system (src/lib/contrast.ts + the --ink switch in Layout.astro); (2) footer copyright/credits (design-contract violation: small text using --color-text-muted, switched to --color-text-secondary); (3) scrollable-region-focusable on code blocks — tabindex=0 via the rehypePreTabindex plugin (markdown fences), CodeFromFile (component code), and the hand-authored .code-block divs in setup/native pages; (4) house-colour prose links — light --color-house-2 darkened #c0512f -> #b74d2d (imperceptible, passes AA on the #f4f1e8 page bg); (5) /setup unstyled prose link (UA default blue) given accessible ink + underline; (6) /setup/roms recommended-tag success green (semantic #22c55e too light as text) made theme-aware.
_gated: 11 template pages gated in both light and dark themes (home, system landing, module, unit, getting-started, vault, family, setup, setup/roms, setup native, pattern category) — all zero serious/critical.
